title: PSG4-QLOG-BANK: counted linear classical control and quadratic basis storage

claims.statement: For every integer N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, the single PSG4-QLOG-BANK physical interpreter in proof.md Sections 0-5 running the selected V in virtual.md Section 1, with n=ceil(log2 N), recovers all of s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8. On every branch, jointly with the other three bounds and zero malformed-fraction guarantee, it has worst-case total charged work T=O(2^((3/4)sqrt(n log2 n)+(3/4)sqrt(n)(log2 n)^(-3/8)-(1/12)sqrt(n)(log2 n)^(-7/16))), with absolute outer constants independent of N,s,outcomes. Logarithmic envelopes apply asymptotically for n>=2; the same explicit finite branch handles n=1. The exact growth index of this representative is 1/2.

For every integer N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, the single PSG4-QLOG-BANK physical interpreter in proof.md Sections 0-5 running the selected V in virtual.md Section 1, with n=ceil(log2 N), recovers all of s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8. On every branch, jointly with the other three bounds and zero malformed-fraction guarantee, it has peak physical classical bits S_C=O(n), with absolute outer constants independent of N,s,outcomes. Logarithmic envelopes apply asymptotically for n>=2; the same explicit finite branch handles n=1. The exact growth index of this representative is 0.

For every integer N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, the single PSG4-QLOG-BANK physical interpreter in proof.md Sections 0-5 running the selected V in virtual.md Section 1, with n=ceil(log2 N), recovers all of s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8. On every branch, jointly with the other three bounds and zero malformed-fraction guarantee, it has peak physical accessible qubits S_Q=O(n^2), including the entire padded basis-state bank, metadata, coherent slots and source temporary wires, with absolute outer constants independent of N,s,outcomes. Logarithmic envelopes apply asymptotically for n>=2; the same explicit finite branch handles n=1. The exact growth index of this representative is 0.

For every integer N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, the single PSG4-QLOG-BANK physical interpreter in proof.md Sections 0-5 running the selected V in virtual.md Section 1, with n=ceil(log2 N), recovers all of s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8. On every branch, jointly with the other three bounds and zero malformed-fraction guarantee, it has total acquired original source copies Q=O(2^((1/2)sqrt(n log2 n)-(3/2)sqrt(n)(log2 n)^(-3/8)+(3/16)sqrt(n)(log2 n)^(-7/16))), with absolute outer constants independent of N,s,outcomes. Logarithmic envelopes apply asymptotically for n>=2; the same explicit finite branch handles n=1. The exact growth index of this representative is 1/2.

For the same single PSG4-QLOG-BANK physical interpreter and configuration in proof.md Sections 0-5 running the selected V in virtual.md Section 1, the proved malformed-sample fraction is epsilon(n)=0. Every acquired source copy is an independent ideal coset state. For every N>=2 and every secret s, this gives unconditional full-secret success at least 1-2^-8 jointly with all four branchwise resource bounds. No positive tolerance or impossibility of positive tolerance is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
